hero.title: Your appointments live in five different places. CareHub brings them into one.
hero.subtitle: Between GP visits, specialist follow-ups, physio, and a parent's check-ups, nobody remembers everything. CareHub keeps every appointment, every provider, and every reminder in one running list you actually keep up with.
hero.disclaimer: CareHub tracks the appointments you tell it about. It doesn't book appointments or check real-time availability at any hospital or clinic.

how.heading: Four steps. No clinic account, no hospital login.
how.step1Body: Search for the clinic, hospital, or doctor you're seeing, or add your own if it's not listed. This is a personal log, not a booking system, so anything goes in.
how.step2Body: Enter the date and time you already booked, by phone, in person, or through the provider's own app. CareHub doesn't check open slots; it just remembers what you told it.
how.step3Body: Pick when you want to be reminded, from an hour before to two days out, so you never show up on the wrong day.
how.step4Body: Every visit rolls into a running timeline per person, so "when did Dad last see the cardiologist" has an actual answer.

who.heading: Built for the person doing the remembering.
who.caregiverEyebrow: If you're keeping track of someone else
who.caregiverBody: Add a profile for a parent, child, or anyone you support, and manage their appointments alongside your own. See who's up next and what's coming this week, across everyone you look after.
who.caregiverPoint1: Multiple care profiles in one account
who.caregiverPoint2: One running list across everyone you support
who.caregiverPoint3: A visit history for each person you manage
who.patientEyebrow: If you're managing your own care
who.patientBody: Stop juggling separate clinic apps and a paper card. Log every appointment as you make it, get reminded before it happens, and pull up your own history whenever a new doctor asks.
who.patientPoint2: Reminders that reach your inbox, not just a portal
who.patientPoint3: A visit history you can show any new doctor

cta.heading: Start with the next appointment on your calendar.
cta.subtitle: Takes under a minute. No clinic integration, no hospital login, just yours.
cta.note: Free for individuals. Add family members anytime.

footer.tagline: A personal appointment tracker for patients and caregivers in Penang.
footer.disclaimer: CareHub is an independent personal tracking tool. It is not affiliated with, and does not exchange data with, any hospital, clinic, or insurance provider.
